description:
Look up the 11 Incoterms 2020 trade rules — who pays for transport, insurance and customs clearance, and where risk transfers from seller to buyer. 7 rules work for any transport mode (EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP); 4 are sea/inland-waterway only (FAS, FOB, CFR, CIF).

Provide code for one rule, category (any_mode | sea_only) for a filtered list, or neither to list all 11 (a list is summary rows — code, name, category, summary — with full: true for the full rules). Behavior: read-only reference; an unknown code errors with the valid code list, and DAT — replaced in Incoterms 2020 — names its successor, DPU (ICC). Rate-limited: a limit error carries reset_at, the UTC time the allowance resets.

Returns: the rule record — name, category, summary, seller_responsibility, buyer_responsibility, risk_transfer, cost_transfer, insurance, export/import clearance, best_for and watch_out — under result, plus confidence, _source and citation (the FreightUtils v1 response envelope).

Limitations: summarised guidance on ICC Incoterms 2020; the ICC publication is the binding text and specific contract wording prevails.

Related: uk_duty_calculator (accepts an incoterm when composing the CIF value), shipment_summary (composite analysis).

Identifiers: Each record carries fu_id, a stable FreightUtils identifier (and fu_version_id where the dataset has editions); resolve_reference resolves one to exactly its record.

category.description: Filter the list: any_mode (7 rules) or sea_only (4 rules).

full.description: Lists only: true returns full records (provenance, sources, rationale) instead of summary rows, five per page by default. A single-record call always returns the full record.

limit.description: Lists only: rows per page (default: every summary row; 5 with full: true).

offset.description: Lists only: rows to skip (default 0). The response gives total and next_offset.

name: incoterms_lookup

kind.description: watched (its upstream is fetched daily) or checksum-only (no upstream of its own).

last_success.description: The last day (YYYY-MM-DD) the upstream check succeeded; null when none is recorded.

stale.description: True only when a dataset below missed its upstream check window (window_missed).

state.description: The worst state of the datasets below.

state_read_at.description: When the site upstream check recorded the state (ISO 8601); null when it could not be read.

anyOf.description: Stable FreightUtils identifier of this record, fu:<namespace>:<key> — the same across editions; resolve_reference resolves it to exactly this record.
This record in one dataset edition, fu_id@<edition>. Present only where the dataset has editions (absent on airlines, ULDs, containers, vehicles).
